text:
Staging should be able to go out today. We're just waiting on QA.

Tests are green, 212/212. One of them was flaky and took two retries to pass. It's not blocking anything, but I'll open a ticket so we can figure out what's going on before it causes real trouble.

QA hasn't signed off yet. They expect to be done by 3, and the deploy window closes at 5. If they finish on time, that gives us about two hours to deploy, run smoke checks, and roll back if something looks wrong. That's enough time, but there isn't much slack if anything slips.

I'll have everything staged so we can deploy as soon as QA signs off. If that's later than around 4, I think we should wait until tomorrow morning instead of rushing right before the window closes.

I'll post here once QA gets back to me. Let me know if you need this sooner or if anything looks off on your side.
